verdict.rationale: Galileo documents capturing every session, trace, and span once an app is instrumented. The SDK offers a `@log` decorator for spans, plus OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing, a first-trace quickstart, and LangChain/LangGraph integration cookbooks, so the core tracing capability is clearly delivered. Cost-based alerts loosely imply usage tracking, but the pack never explicitly states which fields are recorded per call. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that traces record inputs/outputs, latency, and token usage per LLM call; independent or hands-on corroboration.
